summary: Important: .NET 9.0 security, bug fix, and enhancement update
details:
.NET is a fast, lightweight and modular platform for creating cross platform applications that work on Linux, macOS and Windows.  It particularly focuses on creating console applications, web applications and micro-services.  .NET contains a runtime conforming to .NET Standards a set of framework libraries, an SDK containing compilers and a 'dotnet' application to drive everything.

SDK version: 9.0.121
Runtime version: 9.0.20

Security Fix(es):

* dotnet10.0: dotnet9.0: dotnet8.0: .NET Information Disclosure Vulnerability (CVE-2026-58649)

* dotnet10.0: dotnet9.0: .NET Elevation of Privilege Vulnerability (CVE-2026-69806)

Bug Fix(es) and Enhancement(s):

* Update .NET 9.0 to SDK 9.0.121 and Runtime 9.0.20 [rhel-9.8.z] (JIRA:Rocky Linux-252278)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
